text: My husband and I had the true honor of having Heather not only paint our wedding, but literally make our day! Heather was a sweetheart from day 1 of talking all the way up to our wedding day. text: My wife and I met Heather at the Pink Bride show. When we saw her booth we knew we had to have her at our wedding.
